summary: Navidrome is a self-hosted audio streaming server designed to manage and broadcast your personal music collection. It provides a web-based interface and compatibility with existing Subsonic and Airsonic clients to access your media from various devices.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you want to host your own audio library and prefer using established third-party desktop or mobile music apps that support the Subsonic API.
watchOut: You should check whether your preferred client apps are fully compatible with this particular server implementation, as feature support can vary across different Subsonic clients.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, you will typically need to map persistent storage volumes for your music files and database, and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
